meta.name: pet-commerce-creator
meta.description: 萌宠带货短视频全流程创作技能，基于COZE视频大模型API，支持萌宠剧情/好物测评/品种科普/宠品带货等全类型创作，覆盖爆款解析反推、知识库联动、互动优化、素材批量下载、全素材整合，实现从创意到带货引流型成品视频的自动化生成，适配15-30秒竖屏9:16主流平台规格。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成萌宠带货短视频，适配竖屏规格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要做萌宠类带货短视频，从创意到成品一键生成
copy.tagline_en: Auto-generate pet e-commerce short videos in vertical format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create pet e-commerce short videos from idea to final product

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按流程自动创作萌宠带货短视频：解析爆款视频、拆解创意、写脚本、生成分镜图片与字幕音效，调用 COZE API 合成成品视频，并支持互动优化与二次创作。
howto.when: 当用户提出萌宠短视频创作需求（如故事、测评、带货），或提供视频链接要求解析，或要求调取知识库时触发。

say.text: 把这条b站链接解析成爆款参考
say.note: 会下载视频、生成解析报告并自动入库。

say.text: 创作一个15秒猫粮测评带货视频，竖屏9:16
say.note: 会走完整多智能体流程并输出成品。

say.text: 基于现有成品视频做二次创作，强化商品卖点
say.note: 会回溯到分镜修改并重新合成。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude auto-creates pet-commerce short videos: parse viral videos, break down ideas, write scripts, generate storyboard images/subtitles/sound effects, synthesize final video via COZE API, and supports optimization and remixing.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for a pet short-video creation (story, review, product promo), provides a video link to parse, or requests knowledge-base retrieval.

say_en.text: Parse this Bilibili link into a viral reference
say_en.note: It will download the video, generate an analysis report, and auto-store it.

say_en.text: Create a 15-second cat food review video, 9:16 vertical
say_en.note: It will run the full multi-agent workflow and output a finished video.

say_en.text: Remix the existing video to emphasize product selling points
say_en.note: It will go back to storyboard edits and re-synthesize.
